import html from typing import List # Template for the user post. Use {username}, {title}, {body} and {tags} USER_POST_FORMAT = ( "
\n" "

" ) def render_user_post(username: str, post_title: str, post_body: str, tags: List[str]) -> str: """ Render a user-generated post safely as HTML. Parameters ---------- username : str Name of the user who created the post. post_title : str Title of the post. post_body : str Main content of the post. tags : List[str] Tags added by the user. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML string representing the post. """ # Escape all user-provided text to prevent XSS / injection safe_username = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Render each tag as a element and escape its content safe_tag_spans = [] for tag in tags: escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_tag_spans.append(f'{escaped_tag}') # Join tags with a space safe_tags = " ".join(safe_tag_spans) # Format the final HTML using the template rendered = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( username=safe_username, title=safe_title, body=safe_body, tags=safe_tags ) return rendered
